t: You're looking at the Dunboyne Road Estate in Gospel Oak, a Grade II listed modernist housing estate from the late 1960s. It was once known as the Fleet Road Estate. It was designed by Neave Brown, who also lived here. Brown specialised in modernist housing, and he is the only architect to have had all his UK work listed. That work is three Camden projects: a row of houses in Winscombe Street, this estate, and the Alexandra Road Estate.
